Slop CRM · free, in your browser

A simple, free CRM with no sign-up

For a small business that needs a customer list with notes and follow-ups, not a sales platform. Slop CRM runs in your browser and keeps everything on this device.

Open Slop CRM

How to do it

  1. Choose Add customer: contact details, company, addresses, tags and groups, notes, stage and follow-up date.
  2. Open a customer to add dated notes of calls and meetings.
  3. Set a follow-up date; the Follow-ups tab lists them, overdue first.
  4. Filter by group and tag in the sidebar, and sort by name, stage, last activity or follow-up.
  5. See each customer's orders and invoices on their page.

Your files stay on this device: Slop CRM runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is it free with no limit on customers?

Yes. There is no account, no plan and no customer limit; the list is kept in your browser.

Can I import my contacts?

Yes. The customers are the same records as Slop Contacts, so a vCard or CSV imported there appears in the CRM at once.

Can my team share it?

No. It is a single-person CRM: the data is in one browser on one device. A full backup file moves it to another computer.
